svg.title: Duong Thai Tan, full-stack developer
svg.desc: Terminal-style hero. The command whoami types out and the name Duong Thai Tan rises into view while a sheen of light crosses it. The role line types and rotates between full-stack developer, cloud infrastructure builder and visual creator. The line "I build web apps and the cloud systems that run them." fades in. On the right, a git commit graph draws itself from the first commit up to HEAD on main, with feat/web and infra/aws branches merging in; packets of light then travel up main and pulse on arrival at HEAD.

rect.style: --d:54px;animation:in 1ms linear 260ms both,type 420ms steps(6,end) 260ms both,vanish 120ms linear 820ms forwards
--d:216px;animation:in 1ms linear 1300ms both,type 680ms steps(20,end) 1300ms both,rrm 11408ms linear 1980ms 2,rrb 11408ms step-end 1980ms 2
